tagline: As a trusted partner, Orange gives everyone the keys to a responsible digital world.
hero_kpi_rationale: Orange is a leader in fiber deployment in Europe with 46 million FTTH connections at end-2022. This is a structural advantage in a mature sector, reflecting the strategic Lead the Future orientation toward superior connectivity and network-driven differentiation.

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.explanation: Money earned by the company during the year.
kpis.description: Consolidated revenue in 2022, reflecting activities in Europe, Africa and the Middle East.
kpis.signal: Stable revenue in a mature sector.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Difference between revenue and cost of goods sold.
kpis.description: Consolidated gross margin in 2022, indicating strong control over operational costs.
kpis.signal: High gross margin, typical for operators with large subscriber base.

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Earnings before interest and taxes divided by revenue.
kpis.description: Operating margin in 2022, impacted by competition and regulations in France.
kpis.signal: Moderate operating margin, regulatory pressure in Europe.

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures
kpis.explanation: Spending to build or upgrade fixed and mobile networks.
kpis.description: Infrastructure investments in 2022, particularly in fiber optics in France and Europe.
kpis.signal: High Capex, priority on fiber and 5G deployment.

kpis.name: Headcount
kpis.explanation: Total number of employees in the group.
kpis.description: 136,000 employees in 2022, distributed across Europe, Africa and enterprise services.
kpis.signal: High headcount, reflecting operational complexity in B2B and networks.

kpis.name: Mobile Customers
kpis.explanation: Number of subscribers to an Orange mobile plan.
kpis.description: 287 million mobile customers in 2022, including 241.9 million active on Orange's own network.
kpis.signal: Large customer base, but limited growth.

kpis.name: Fixed Broadband Customers
kpis.explanation: Number of subscribers to fixed very high-speed internet (FTTH).
kpis.description: 24.3 million fixed broadband customers, including 13.7 million on fiber optic (FTTH).
kpis.signal: Fiber growth in France and Europe, a key competitive advantage.

ai_positioning.summary: Orange takes a cautious approach toward AI, with no major initiatives announced. AI is mentioned as a future opportunity, but not yet integrated into core products.
evidence: No mention of generative AI or AI APIs in reports.
Lead the Future strategy focused on fiber and cybersecurity, not AI.
Call for Big Tech to fund networks, without AI-related reciprocity.
